name: Break Loops
author: Freek van Gool
description: Fourteen two-bar drum loops for breakbeat, jungle, drum and bass and boom bap, rendered offline from the Drum Kit and Pulse Drums devices of this repository (stereo, 44.1 kHz, lossless FLAC). The patterns are original. Checked by measurement (length, level, loop seam, onset timing); not listened to.
